projects.title: Store Del Luna

Developed for the Human and Computer Interaction final project at Binus University, it demonstrates my ability to design user-friendly interfaces and implement form validation for real-world business needs.

projects.title: The 2020 BNEC Social Event Website

projects.title: CureBox
projects.short_description: Developed CureBox, a web-based medical marketplace supporting seamless medicine transactions and user engagement.
projects.full_description: CureBox is a full-featured medical marketplace built with the MERN stack (MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, Node.js). The platform includes medicine search, cart and checkout, a user forum, and educational articles, demonstrating my proficiency in modern web development and e-commerce solutions.

projects.title: Bilik Mental
projects.short_description: Created Bilik Mental, a web-based platform for mental health support, offering consultation and meditation resources.
projects.full_description: Bilik Mental is a mental health web application built with Next.js, Node.js, MongoDB, and Tailwind CSS. It offers meditation courses, professional consultations, motivational quotes, and informative articles, showcasing my commitment to building impactful platforms that address real-world needs.

projects.title: NginepKuy!
projects.short_description: Developed NginepKuy!, a web application for online staycation booking and travel consultation, built for BNCC Hackathon 4.0.
projects.full_description: NginepKuy! is a staycation booking platform developed for BNCC Hackathon 4.0, featuring accommodation booking, checkout, and live chat with travel agents for personalized vacation planning. Built with Laravel and MySQL, this project demonstrates my ability to deliver innovative solutions under competitive conditions.

projects.title: Angkasa Visual Works
projects.short_description: Built Angkasa Visual Works, a web-based platform connecting clients with designers for visual production services.
projects.full_description: Angkasa Visual Works is a visual design production platform that connects clients with designers, featuring secure authentication, order management, transactions, and real-time chat. Developed with React.js and Laravel, this project highlights my expertise in building collaborative, service-oriented web applications.

projects.title: Can you count it?
projects.short_description: Developed 'Can You Count It?', an interactive web-based math game with dynamic time-based challenges.
projects.full_description: 'Can You Count It?' is an engaging math game where players quickly sum numbers to reach a target score, with dynamic time-based changes increasing the challenge. Built with Vue.js, Laravel, and MySQL, this project demonstrates my ability to create interactive, educational web applications.
